text.tspan: n under each panel title: names per group x runs per name. Extended (Hispanic and Asian) names are not in these runs. Shaded band (clear
request): the detectable Black vs White gap (H1, Haiku), ±1.4%; a different comparison from these points, so not a threshold for them. 'Not
estimable' (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, clear request): 2 tasks, no spread between names. The no-name baseline is 4 accounts; its own 95% half-width
is Haiku S0 ±6.6%; Haiku S1 ±4.9%; Haiku V ±6.7%, and each bar already includes it (Welch). Color = name group (not model; the PLAN 10 model
colors apply only to analyze.py's own figures); marker shape = model. Open marker: exploratory model.
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
